The '''''Crescent''-class Mark II Transport''' or '''''Crescent''-class Mark II freighter''' was a fast luxury [[Courier/Legends|courier]] manufactured by [[Hyrotii Corporation/Legends|Hyrotii Corporation]].

==Description==
The ''Crescent''-class Mark II Transport was a variant of the [[Crescent-class Transport|''Crescent''-class Transport]] that did not come equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. As a result, it had more room for cargo and a larger lounge area.<ref name="SS" />
